artifact_reasoning: Significant artifacts detract from the score. 1) Texture Anomaly: The fur lacks individual strand definition, appearing smudged/painted (Severity ~1.5). 2) Structural Collapse: The front right paw merges indistinctly with the rock surface, lacking clear digit definition (Severity ~2.0). 3) Eye Artifact: The eye has an unnatural, uniform plastic sheen (Severity ~1.0). While the overall structure is sound, these textural and boundary issues prevent a higher artifact score. The reference image 000002 (hammerhead, artifact 3.0) had more severe structural warping; this image is better structurally but suffers from similar textural 'AI-smoothness', justifying a score slightly below 3.0.
